teaser.en: When a stomach ache is blamed on someone's evil look, this spiny bush shrub is the remedy people reach for.
teaser.sw: Maumivu ya tumbo yanaposhukiwa kusababishwa na jicho baya la mtu, kichaka hiki chenye miiba ndicho dawa ambayo watu hukimbilia.
teaser.dg: Mutu achilumwa ni ndani, na ikagombwa ni kpwa sababu ya dzitso ribaya ra mutu, chitsaka chihi chenye miya cha weruni ndicho dawa ambayo atu nkuhendza.

summary.en: *Mtengedzi* is a spiny bush shrub with small clustered leaves and yellowish round fruits. It is used to treat *dzongo*, a stomach ailment believed to be caused by evil looks.
summary.sw: *Mtengedzi* ni kichaka cha porini chenye miiba, majani madogo yaliyokaa kwa vishada na matunda ya mviringo ya rangi ya manjano hafifu. Hutumika kutibu *dzongo*, ugonjwa wa tumbo unaoaminika kusababishwa na jicho baya.
summary.dg: *Mtengedzi* ni chitsaka chenye miya cha weruni, chenye makodza madide ganayomera kpwa makundi na matunda ga mviringo ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu. Nkuhumirwa kuphoza *dzongo*, ukongo wa ndani ambao atu anaamini unarehwa ni dzitso ribaya.

about.en: *Mtengedzi* is a stiff, spiny shrub of the coffee family. Its small leaves grow in clusters along the stems, often at the base of the spines. The fruits are round and yellowish when ripe.
about.sw: *Mtengedzi* ni kichaka kigumu chenye miiba, cha familia ya mibuni. Majani yake madogo hukua kwa vishada kando ya mashina, mara nyingi chini ya miiba. Matunda yake ni ya mviringo na huwa ya rangi ya manjano hafifu yakiiva.
about.dg: *Mtengedzi* ni chitsaka chigumu chenye miya, cha jamii ya kahawa. Makodzage madide ganamera kpwa makundi kanda-kanda ya panda, mara nyinji photsi ya miya. Matunda ni ga mviringo, na ni ga rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu gachiivwa.

uses.en: It is used to treat *dzongo*, a stomach ailment.

culture.en: *Dzongo* is believed to be caused by evil looks, an illness sent by a jealous or ill-wishing glance. Its second Digo name, *mdzongodzongo*, carries the name of the ailment it treats.
culture.sw: *Dzongo* huaminika kusababishwa na jicho baya, yaani ugonjwa unaoletwa na mtazamo wa mtu mwenye wivu au asiyekutakia mema. Jina lake la pili la Kidigo, *mdzongodzongo*, limebeba jina la ugonjwa unaotibiwa nacho.
culture.dg: Atu anaamini *dzongo* inarehwa ni dzitso ribaya, ukongo unaohumwa ni kulolwa ni mutu mwenye wivu au mwenye moyo mui. Dzinare ra phiri ra Chidigo, *mdzongodzongo*, rina dzina ra ukongo unaouphoza.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mtengedzi* and *mdzongodzongo*; the Mgombato dictionary also lists *mdzongodzongo* with *mtengedzi* as its equivalent. *Mtengedzi* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Catunaregam nilotica*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mtengedzi* na *mdzongodzongo*; kamusi ya Mgombato pia inaorodhesha *mdzongodzongo* ikitoa *mtengedzi* kama kisawe chake. *Mtengedzi* ni jina linalotumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea hukiita *Catunaregam nilotica*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mtengedzi* na *mdzongodzongo*; Mgombato piya unaandika *mdzongodzongo*, na unapha *mtengedzi* dza dzina ranjina ra muhi uo uo. *Mtengedzi* piya ni dzina ra Chiduruma, Chigiriama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza takuna dzina ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Catunaregam nilotica*.
